decisive_items: Bone marrow smear and tissue showed trilineage hematopoiesis with histiocytes and hemophagocytosis
Groups of apoptotic bodies, abundant pink cytoplasmic fragments and small blue dots of fragmented nuclei in confluent necroptosis area
Markedly expanded paracortex (CD3+ T cells), limited CD20+ B cells in residual reactive follicles, positive CD68 and myeloperoxidase in histiocytes
response.rationale: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow, necroptotic lymph node with T-cell expansion and histiocytic infiltration, fever, splenomegaly, and CNS inflammation strongly support hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis. Influenza exposure is only a possible trigger, and low-titer ANA with negative ENA is nonspecific.

rejected.why: Low-titer ANA with negative ENA/APL/ANCA and insufficient SLE-defining clinical criteria; the hemophagocytosis and necroptotic lymph node findings are better explained by HLH.
